summary:
Main
Today, the DCE iron ore futures futures consolidated on a subdued note. The most-traded DCE I2609 futures contract closed at 746 yuan/mt,down 0.13%. Spot prices at Qingdao Port fell about 2-3 yuan/mt from the previous trading day.
